reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Upgraded Helm version with breaking changes: Helm was upgraded to 3.17.1", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Rendered Kubernetes objects are overridden with the invalid null value from values.yaml null objects, which may require changing subchart values.yaml files.
consequence.remediation: Identify values.yaml files with null object values and remove those null values.

proposed.statement: Helm was upgraded to 3.17.1, so a null object in subchart values.yaml now overrides the rendered K8s object with the invalid null value (previously it was not overridden).
